title: Great Falls Park B-Roll package
place: Great Falls of the Potomac River, Great Falls Park, Virginia (Virginia-Maryland border)
notes: Single locked-off shot (source 44.2-79.0 s is one continuous shot): wide white-water cascades of the Potomac at dawn/dusk, mist rising and drifting over the rocks, pinkish sky. Source 1280x720 23.976p, upscaled and converted to 30 fps. Main 20-ft drops across x 0.1-0.65 at y~0.6-0.7, big dark boulder x~0.6-0.85; dark cliff in lower-left corner. Square crop centre x~0.45. All 14 s usable (static, mist moves). No people in this segment (other parts of the package show visitors with faces and park signs - avoided). No text/logos in the cut.
fact_en: Great Falls of the Potomac: rapids and several 20 foot waterfalls, 'with a total 76 foot drop in elevation over a distance of less than a mile.'
